entries.competence: Knowledge of national cultural values of willingness to promote the positive ones.
entries.objective: Show an understanding and appreciation of national cultural values.
entries.sub_topic: (a) Aspect of culture and elements of culture.
entries.teaching_act: The teacher to guide students on the meaning of a culture, aspects and elements of culture, importances.
entries.learning_act: Students discuss and present on meaning aspects, elements and importance of culture.
entries.assessment: Explain the -Meaning of culture. -The aspect of culture.

entries.competence: Knowledge of national cultural values of willingness to promote the positive ones.
entries.objective: Show an understanding and appreciation of national cultural values.
entries.sub_topic: (b) Positive and negative aspect of cultural values.
entries.teaching_act: The teacher to assign questions to students to discuss and identify positive and negative aspect of our cultural values.
entries.learning_act: Learners discuss and present their finding about positive and negative aspect of cultural values.
entries.materials: Written sources on gender and culture.
entries.assessment: Illustrate customs which lead to gender discrimination.

entries.competence: Knowledge of national cultural values of willingness to promote the positive ones.
entries.objective: Show an understanding and appreciation of national cultural values.
entries.sub_topic: (c) Promotion & presentation of our cultural values.
entries.assessment: Explain the meaning of promotion & preserving cultural values.

entries.sub_topic: (d) Culture of prevention care and maintenance

entries.assessment: Demonstrate how to use different life skills.

entries.competence: Demonstrate the ability to collect, identify, classify and analyse information on prevailing globalisation issues and their effects on Tanzania and deal with them at personal level
entries.objective: By the end of the course, students should be able to show an understanding of globalisation issues and ability to alleviate their negative effects at personal level.
entries.sub_topic: (a) The concept and aspects of GLOBALISATION
entries.teaching_act: The teacher to guide students in groups to read and explain the meaning of globalisation aspects of globalisation such as democratization, free market economy.
entries.learning_act: Students present their findings to the class for further clarification and summary.
entries.materials: New paper, radios, journal, handouts or reports.
entries.assessment: (i) Explain the concept of globalisation (ii) The aspects of globalisation.

entries.teaching_act: The teacher to guide students to carry out a library research individually on the effects of globalisation in Tanzania and write brief notes.
entries.learning_act: Students in their groups to present their findings for class presentations about effects of Globalisation in Tanzania.
entries.materials: Written texts on globalisation and its effects in Tanzania.
entries.assessment: Examine the effects of globalisation in Tanzania.

entries.teaching_act: The teacher to guide students to read written sources individually on globalization and identify challenges of globalisation for Tanzania.
entries.learning_act: Students present their findings on challenges of globalisation in Tanzania.
entries.materials: Written texts on globalisation and its challenges in Tanzania.
entries.assessment: Analyse the challenges of globalisation issues for Tanzania.
